title: Vintage Posters & Graphic Design
description: Public-domain poster art — Art Nouveau, Belle Époque, and golden-age travel design.

items.title: Moulin Rouge: La Goulue
items.description_narrative: Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec's iconic poster, "Moulin Rouge: La Goulue," vividly captures the vibrant nightlife of Belle Époque Paris, advertising the famous cabaret. It features the celebrated can-can dancer La Goulue, recognizable by her flamboyant presence and the artist's distinctive bold, graphic style.
items.tags: poster, cabaret, Belle Époque, Paris, dance, nightlife, post-impressionism, advertising

items.title: Divan Japonais
items.description_narrative: This iconic lithograph by Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec advertises the Divan Japonais, a Montmartre café-cabaret. It vividly captures the Parisian nightlife of the Belle Époque, featuring the performer Jane Avril and the critic Édouard Dujardin in the audience, with Yvette Guilbert's distinctive gloves and silhouette hinting at her presence on stage.
items.tags: poster, lithograph, cabaret, parisian nightlife, belle époque, montmartre, advertising, post-impressionism

items.title: Aristide Bruant dans son cabaret
items.description_narrative: This iconic color lithograph by Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec vividly portrays the famous singer Aristide Bruant, identifiable by his distinctive red scarf and black cape. Created as a promotional poster, it captures the raw energy of Montmartre's Belle Époque cabarets through its bold lines and striking silhouette.
items.tags: cabaret, parisian nightlife, poster, lithograph, art nouveau, performance, montmartre

items.title: Jane Avril
items.description_narrative: Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec's poster immortalizes the French can-can dancer Jane Avril, a prominent figure of Parisian nightlife. Characterized by its bold lines and striking color contrasts, the artwork captures the energy and allure of fin-de-siècle entertainment.
items.tags: parisian nightlife, can-can dancer, art nouveau, poster art, Belle Époque, entertainment, bohemian, vibrant

items.title: Gismonda
items.description_narrative: Alphonse Mucha's iconic poster "Gismonda" launched his career and became synonymous with the Art Nouveau style, designed for the celebrated actress Sarah Bernhardt. The elongated figure and intricate, decorative elements, reminiscent of Byzantine mosaics, captured the public's imagination.
items.tags: art nouveau, poster, sarah bernhardt, theatre, graphic design, decorative, elegant, byzantine-inspired

items.title: Job
items.description_narrative: Alphonse Mucha's iconic poster 'Job' advertises cigarette papers through an idealized female figure. The artwork exemplifies the flowing lines and decorative elements characteristic of the Art Nouveau movement, making it a celebrated commercial art piece.
items.tags: art nouveau, advertising, poster, woman, decorative, lithography, commercial art

items.title: Bières de la Meuse
items.description_narrative: This iconic poster by Alphonse Mucha features an elegant female figure, adorned with flowing hair and elaborate decorative motifs, embodying the graceful aesthetic of the Art Nouveau movement. Created as an advertisement for Bières de la Meuse, it exemplifies Mucha's mastery in commercial art and design.
items.tags: art nouveau, advertising, lithograph, poster art, woman, decorative, elegant, commercial

items.title: Le Chat Noir
items.description_narrative: This iconic poster, created for the famous Le Chat Noir cabaret in Montmartre, Paris, vividly captures the spirit of late 19th-century Parisian nightlife. It features the establishment's distinctive black cat with an enigmatic gaze, serving as a powerful and enduring symbol.
items.tags: cabaret, black cat, advertising, art nouveau, paris, poster art, belle époque, nightlife

items.title: Folies Bergère
items.description_narrative: Jules Chéret's vibrant design for the Folies Bergère captures the lively spirit of Parisian entertainment during the Belle Époque. The artist's innovative use of color lithography transformed advertising into a popular art form.
items.tags: poster art, belle époque, advertising, parisian life, entertainment, lithography, french art
